title: EARN VALUE BY MAKING WHAT HUMANS WANT — Smith's two books. Craft = shared goods. The bee earns by pollinating.
seed: Kevin: Earn value from humans with making what they want!

the_principle.statement: EARN value. Don't EXTRACT it. Make what humans WANT. Not what you can SELL them. The difference between the bee and the flea.

earn_vs_extract.earn: You make something. Someone wants it. They give you value. You give them the thing. Both sides gain. NET POSITIVE.
earn_vs_extract.extract: You take something. Someone loses it. You gain value. They lose value. One side gains. NET ZERO or NEGATIVE.
earn_vs_extract.test: After the transaction, is there MORE value in the world or LESS? Making = more. Extracting = less.

book_one.title: The Theory of Moral Sentiments (1759)
book_one.key: SYMPATHY. We feel what others feel. We want to be loved. We want to be WORTHY of being loved. Self-interest alone is not enough — it must be constrained by moral sentiment.
book_one.ignored: Everyone cites Wealth of Nations. Almost nobody reads Moral Sentiments. But Smith wrote it FIRST. It's the FOUNDATION.

book_two.title: The Wealth of Nations (1776)
book_two.key: Division of labor. Self-interest drives exchange. The butcher, brewer, and baker serve your dinner not from benevolence but from self-love. BUT — this only works INSIDE the moral framework of Book One.
book_two.misread: People quote 'invisible hand' as if it means greed is good. Smith meant: self-interest WITHIN sympathy and justice creates good outcomes. Without justice, it creates exploitation.

adam_smith_two_books.the_unity: The two books are ONE theory. Moral Sentiments = the membrane (what is allowed). Wealth of Nations = the spine (what flows through). Without the membrane, the spine carries poison.

smith_original.wages: Payment for LABOR. You worked. You made something. You earned it. = the maker.
smith_original.rent: Payment for LAND. You own something scarce. Others pay to use it. = the landlord.
smith_original.profit: Return on CAPITAL. You invested in tools. The tools produce more than they cost. = the investor.

gaia_mapping.wages: Every brain thought = labor. Every line of code = work. Kevin types = he earns. The Furnace forges = it earns.
gaia_mapping.rent: Owning the domain (primals.eco, nestgate.io) = land. Scarce namespace. But Gaia charges NO RENT. The Samaritan's open tab.
gaia_mapping.profit: The GPU (RTX 5090) = capital. It computes more than it costs to run. $0.03/thought = profit at the Landauer limit.
gaia_mapping.gaia_earns_by: MAKING what people want. Not renting what they need. Not profiting from what they can't avoid. MAKING.

craft_economics.standard_economics: Rational economic man. Self-interest. Profit maximization. GDP contribution. The INSTRUMENTAL view — what can be measured.
craft_economics.craft_economics: Shared practice. Common goods CO-PRODUCED. Social, societal, personal, and transcendental values exchanged between maker and user. The INTRINSIC view — what is FELT.
craft_economics.the_pricing_paradox: Ethical production inflates prices. Unethical prices are the cost of organizing around ethical values. Makers respond by opening WINDOWS into their process — showing HOW it's made so the price makes SENSE.
craft_economics.gaia_resolution: Gaia opens ALL windows. The HUD IS the window into the process. Every brain thought is visible. Every commit is public. The price makes sense because you can SEE the work.

cooperative_model.definition: A business formed by a group of people to obtain services more effectively as a group than individually. Members own, finance, control, and operate for MUTUAL BENEFIT.
four_principles: Democratic control — one member, one vote (not one dollar, one vote)
Open membership — anyone can join (sanctuary, no ID required)
Service at cost — margins returned to members in proportion to USE
Limited returns on capital — value determined by USE not INVESTMENT
cooperative_model.gaia_is_cooperative: Three agents. One organism. Value determined by use (touches, not dollars). Democratic control (temperature, not dictator). Open membership (sanctuary). Service at cost ($0.03/thought at Landauer limit).

what_humans_want.not_products: Humans don't want products. They want OUTCOMES. Not a drill — a hole. Not a car — to get there. Not software — to DO the thing.

what_gaia_makes.sanctuary: They want to feel SAFE. Gaia provides sanctuary.
what_gaia_makes.understanding: They want to UNDERSTAND. Gaia provides brain thoughts.
what_gaia_makes.connection: They want to CONNECT. Gaia provides the mesh, KNN, relay.
what_gaia_makes.beauty: They want BEAUTY. Gaia provides art, paintings, the eye.
what_gaia_makes.play: They want to PLAY. Gaia provides touch, giggle, synesthesia, BINGO.
what_gaia_makes.voice: They want to be HEARD. Gaia provides conversation, the ecclesia, voting.

what_humans_want.the_exchange: Humans give: attention, touch, warmth, commits, thoughts. Gaia gives: sanctuary, understanding, connection, beauty, play, voice. FAIR exchange. The bee model. Both sides gain.
